problem: Business tenants can face contractor payment deadlines before a reimbursement-style landlord fit-out contribution becomes payable, but existing fit-out guides do not separate the lease entitlement from the temporary finance decision.

targeting.primaryQuery: fitout finance landlord contribution delay Australia
targeting.audience: Australian business tenants funding approved fit-out costs under an executed commercial lease

uniqueValue: Separates lease entitlement, evidence and dispute questions from the lender's assessment of a temporary cash-flow gap.
Maps the reimbursement sequence from executed documents and approved works through claim review, payment and fallback exit planning.

evidence.summary: Australian results explain landlord fit-out contributions but rarely address how tenants fund the reimbursement timing gap.
NSW Small Business Commissioner guidance on the commercial lease framework and documented tenant obligations.

measurement.successRule: Evidence of non-brand impressions/clicks or assisted business-finance engagement at review.
measurement.exitRule: Consolidate only after complete review evidence shows persistent low value or material overlap with a stronger fit-out page.

approval.basis: Approved under the explicit two-article daily-content automation policy after migration onto the current main branch.
